401890401.text: It's time, dear partner and Paimon, for us to turn our attention to the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland...

401890402.text: As I mentioned, the park was started up by enthusiasts, who brought in the Spina di Rosula to handle the planning, construction, and operations.

401890403.text: Of course, enthusiasts aren't typically all-around experts. They usually stick to designing the event booths.

401890404.text: We, for our part, handle long-term operations and develop standardized strategy guides for the different activities.

401890405.text: Long-term operations, strategy... It all sounds so complicated!

401890406.text: We spend most of our time adventuring, and we barely have any experience running a stall... Do you think we can handle this?

401890409.text: That's more like it! You've seen it all before, haven't you, partner? I'd even go as far as to say you've shaped some of Teyvat's biggest business ventures!

401890410.text: Anyway! First things first, let's get an overview of how the whole festival's gonna be run...

401890411.text: #Ah, Paimon thinks she just about gets it. How do you feel about it, {NICKNAME}?

401890601.text: Both of you seem even more excited than before. Looks like your first trial run didn't disappoint!

401890604.text: Paimon hasn't actually watched that many films, but after trying it out... she might just be hooked! We should check out the film that it's based on!

401890605.text: Great job, Paimon! That's exactly what our enthusiast friends were hoping you'd say.

401890606.text: They'd be beyond delighted to hear that visitors are curious about the films that inspired these attractions!

401890607.text: Some have even been willing to contribute extra funds out of their own pockets — where budgets have allowed, of course.

401890609.text: That's right! While the Spina di Rosula covers the cost of basic booth materials and rental fees, many fans have personally funded promotional materials and related merchandise.

401890610.text: The cost of the booth itself isn't their main expense. Some of them have already started designing spin-off products inspired by film characters.

401890611.text: Take our official mascot, Surintendante Chevalmarin, for instance. She won second place in the last "Most Popular Character" poll for the comic film category, and was even dubbed "the pinnacle of round, bouncy cuteness."

401890612.text: Many people have expressed interest in designing cushions based on her image, using the highest quality fabrics and hiring the most skilled artisans to mass-produce them...

401890613.text: These cushions will officially go on sale at the next convention alongside lots of similar products!

401890801.text: Looks like this particular employee is really getting into their role...

401890804.text: Hahaha, you're both doing great. You sound more like bosses than I do!

401890805.text: In any case, with this, the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland is now officially open!

401890806.text: Running a theme park is a long-term project. You won't make much if you try and rush it.

401890807.text: We're just about done with our current work setup, so let's take a short break and wait for this cycle's revenue report to come in.

401890501.text: Alright then. Time to try out Eclectic Escapades. I'll leave the strategy guide to you guys!

401891001.text: Well, the numbers might not look that impressive, but given that we're just getting the ball rolling, I'd say that wasn't a bad start!

401891002.text: Building on this momentum, we must consider rolling out more unique business strategies during the next cycle!

401891003.text: To draw in the crowds, I've invited one of Fontaine's very own celebrity chefs — my good friend Escoffier!

401891004.text: She'll be "performing" right here in the amusement park's restaurant. On that note, let's go catch up with her!

401891005.text: So is the restaurant part of our business strategy too? There are so many layers to this operation...

subQuests.subQuestName: Choose a theme dish to make

401890701.text: When reviewing resumes, pay attention to each applicant's area of expertise!

401891401.text: I've refined the sauce for these Barbeque Ribs. It's a richer flavor than the classic version, but not at all greasy.

401891402.text: The Mint extract in the seasoning leaves a refreshing aftertaste — perfect for indulging yourself after a fun-filled day.

401891403.text: But if you ask me, I'd say the artisans need these more than the guests.

401891405.text: As I'm sure you've noticed, this park isn't quite finished. A serving of these Barbeque Ribs should help the artisans replenish their strength much more quickly.

401891406.text: As their bosses, you have an obligation to provide meals for them. So why not invite them to dine here?

401891407.text: Who knows, the morale boost might even improve their productivity.

401891408.text: Oh? If I recall correctly, you once served up some special Fish and Chips for the porters over at the Fleuve Cendre...

401891409.text: For several days after, the workers were all incredibly efficient. They'd finish eight hours of work in just five, and then because they clocked out early, they'd come back completely refreshed the next day.

401891410.text: Then there's no time to lose. Go invite the artisans over while these ribs are still hot. I'll prepare some side dishes and desserts too.

401891411.text: That's a great idea! You really live up to your reputation, Escoffier!

401891412.text: Looks like these theme dishes are gonna make a huge difference after all! We'll have to make sure we check in with you regularly!

401891413.text: You and Navia invite the artisans over, treating them to a delicious feast of special Barbeque Ribs...

401890901.text: Well, this cycle of operations sure got us off to a good start. On to the next one!

401891601.text: Whew... That should be everything. Looks like you've pretty much mastered how to run this park!

401891603.text: Thinking about it... We have learned quite a lot, haven't we?

401891606.text: Not at all. I wouldn't say I taught you much. Your intuition's been guiding the way, mostly!

401891607.text: I imagine "long-term operations" sounded like a scary prospect the first time I mentioned it, huh?

401891608.text: But don't let that scare you! Just break things down into smaller steps and tackle them one at a time. Even if you're not a genius or naturally gifted, you'll get it done in the end!

401891609.text: Whoa, seeing her own progress has really got Paimon fired up! Actually, she's gonna jot your words of encouragement right down, hehe...

401891610.text: From here on out, we'll be running the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland together — let's make it a big success!

401890102.text: Ready to join the Chevalmarin Film Fantasyland crew?

401890301.text: Let me get a few other things in order first.

401890302.text: No problem. We'll be ready when you are!

401891102.text: The restaurant is up to standard, and the waterside location will make for a unique dining experience. The beautiful scenic reflections in the water create a stunning backdrop, lifting diners' spirits and allowing them to truly savor their meals.

401891103.text: Ingredients, check... Cooking utensils, check... Looks like we're ready to rumble.

401891106.text: #The president of the Spina di Rosula, plus the famous {NICKNAME} and Paimon... I must say, you seem a bit overqualified to be running a film-themed amusement park.

401891107.text: I'd say that if anyone here was overqualified, it would be the former head chef of the Hotel Debord... Wherever you walk, the aroma of fine cuisine follows in your wake.

401891108.text: Ahem... Let's get back to business.

401891109.text: #I'm guessing you want {NICKNAME} to help me decide the theme dish for each cycle. Right?

401891111.text: This is the business strategy I mentioned earlier — using Escoffier's top-tier dishes to attract more visitors to the park!

401891112.text: But this isn't just about attracting visitors. Her culinary masterpieces will surely have other surprising effects!

401891113.text: Just imagine, Paimon, if all you needed was a single ticket to enjoy all the attractions and taste all the legendary food... Wouldn't you be tempted?

401891114.text: Th—Th—Th... Then Paimon'd come every single day...

401891117.text: Now, here's the twist: To get the most out of this strategy, the menu can't be made public.

401891118.text: Based on research by a certain food branding consultant, many restaurants have started offering a special "Chef's Surprise" dish.

401891119.text: So, give me some inspiration every few business cycles, and I'll decide on our next theme dish.

401891120.text: Now then, give me your hand.

401891201.text: Alright! Let's find out what "strength" looks like in gastronomical form...

401891301.text: Aha! The essence of Escoffier's classic improvisational method — "mystery dishes inspired by key ingredients," as she puts it!

401891501.text: Now that everything's going smoothly, it's about time we upgraded our facilities!

401899901.text: The artisans are pumped and ready to roll thanks to that theme dish!

401899902.text: And perfect timing, too! Let's take this chance to take the facilities of our Eclectic Escapades to the next level.

401899903.text: As you can see, our Fantasyland's a bit like a sugar-free macaron right now... Several areas are still under construction.

401899904.text: The Spina's only been able to hire a limited number of craftsmen. Besides, we don't have enough experience to handle multiple projects simultaneously.

401899905.text: That's why I chose to adopt a time slot-based planning method, so we can focus on specific tasks during each designated period.

401899906.text: Upgrading facilities, expanding the venue, hiring staff... All of this requires funds and time slots to accomplish.

401899907.text: So it's our job to allocate precious time slots in each business cycle to the most worthwhile tasks.

401899908.text: As we attract more guests and earn money to add to our funds, we'll also be able to work more efficiently...

401899909.text: Which will allow us to divide each cycle into finer time slots, which will let us get more done!

401899910.text: So... we'll be limited in the decisions we can make and tasks we can focus on within each time period.

401899911.text: Which means we have to use our limited actions and Mora to earn even more Mora!

401899912.text: Kinda like playing chess or cards, then. Cooking up a strategy in advance is gonna be key.

401899913.text: We should be able to attract more customers by upgrading this stall, don'cha think?

401899914.text: That's right! Based on my business experience with the Spina di Rosula, I've quantified the "service value" to help you intuitively understand how satisfied customers are with each stall.

401899915.text: An attraction will reach its ideal revenue only when its "service value" meets customer expectations. As we improve and expand our facilities, expectations will also increase accordingly.

401899916.text: When that happens, we can deploy more capable employees, or invest funds in training to enhance our employees' skills!
